headline: I used Jev, @typesafeai System 1 model, to train a tiny Snake player.

media.alt: Video from the post by Adamya

text:
I used Jev, @typesafeai System 1 model, to train a tiny Snake player.

It agrees with Jev 93% of the time, runs 800× faster on a laptop, and costs $0 per call.

Then I spent that speed on looking ahead. It scored 5× higher than the model it learned from.
